_about: The site's own words, every language. English is the reference; each language translates it (the slogan «Love What You Do», «Lewydo», game names and «Google Play» are never translated). **bold** and *emphasis* are allowed; {n} is the number of a plural string (one/few/many/other). Words about CubePix — and the About text, the same in every Lewydo game — come from the game itself (src/cubepix.json, keys cp:…). Edit here, then npm run build.

en.meta.title: Lewydo™ — Love What You Do · indie game studio from Ukraine
en.meta.desc: Lewydo is a two-person indie game studio from Ukraine. Vlad codes, Lilya designs. Play CubePix and Orbit Dash right on this page, and find all our games on Google Play.
en.nav.label: Main menu
en.lang.title: Language
en.hero.h1: Lewydo — an indie game studio from Ukraine
en.hero.lead: We are Vlad and Lilya. **He codes, she designs** — and together we make the games we love to play.
en.hero.replay: The Lewydo heart. Tap to build it again
en.worlds.title: Every game is its own world
en.worlds.lead: Step inside and play right here: the page changes with every world.
en.cp.next: Liked it? A whole museum of pictures is waiting in the free demo.
en.cp.aria: CubePix mini-puzzle: fill the cells that show your cube's number
en.od.lead: Switch lanes with a single tap, graze the spikes for combos and bank the gems before they get you. Unlock Orbit III and climb the global leaderboard.
en.od.aria: Orbit Dash mini-game. Tap it or press Space to switch orbits
en.more.title: More from Lewydo
en.more.lead: A relaxing merge puzzle, a cozy clicker and interactive guides for game developers — all on Google Play.
en.game.imc.d: Drag. Merge. Evolve. A relaxing idle merge puzzle with goals, daily rewards and endless cube progression.
en.game.joints.d: An interactive guide to Box2D joints in LibGDX, with live examples, animations and useful links. Made by a LibGDX developer for LibGDX developers.
en.game.light.d: Play with four kinds of 2D light: point, cone, chain and directional. Move the lights, cast shadows and tweak every setting.
en.game.autumn.d: A cozy autumn clicker with falling leaves, warm colors, nature sounds to unlock and leaderboards. No timers, no pressure: just tap and unwind.
en.studio.title: Two people, one heart
en.cd.title: He codes. She designs.
en.cd.text: Drag the slider: this is how every Lewydo game is born, from Vlad's code to Lilya's design.
en.p.vlad.who: Vlad, Android and LibGDX developer · Poltava region, Ukraine
en.p.vlad.bio: Writing code since 2017: Java first, Kotlin a year later. A full-time game developer since 2021, from trainee all the way to Team Lead at a game studio. Every Lewydo game is built with Kotlin and LibGDX, Android first.
en.p.lilya.who: Liliia Overchenko, web and UX/UI designer
en.p.lilya.bio: Websites, presentation design and social media visuals are her main field. Thanks to Vlad she stepped into game design too, and every Lewydo game carries her touch. *Between us: websites are still her first love* 😉
en.story.title: Our story so far
en.story.1.d: Vlad writes his first code. A year later he switches to Kotlin and stays with it for good.
en.story.2.d: Vlad leaves the Military Institute of Telecommunications behind and goes full-time into games: trainee, junior… all the way to Team Lead.
en.story.3.d: A developer meets a designer. The studio doesn't know it exists yet.
en.story.4.d: Same day, different month — a team forever.
en.story.5.d: We make our own games together in the Poltava region, Ukraine. Orbit Dash is already on Google Play, and CubePix is on its way.
en.contact.title: Let's make something you'll love
en.contact.text: Have an interesting partnership in mind, or need a high-quality game built? Write to us — we'd love to hear from you.
en.foot.made: Made with 💚 in the Poltava region, Ukraine 🇺🇦
